subject: Next steps: hosted evaluation, endpoints & rate caps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@ledgerio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation — quick follow-up & questions

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for your time on the demo this morning. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can size the right onramp for Ledgerio: 

TL;DR: Hosted API looks like a good fit to start. Need your answers below to finalize sandbox endpoints and initial rate caps.

What we covered
- Primary flow: customer support triage + short-form answer generation (template + retrieval).
- Desired latency: <300ms p95 for short prompts, <600ms for multi-step flows.
- Security: SOC 2 and data residency in us-east preferred.

Questions for sizing (please paste short answers or attach a CSV):
1) Typical concurrent QPS during peak traffic? (est. requests/sec)
2) Average request/response token counts (input tokens / output tokens)
3) Percentage of requests that require long context (>= 2k tokens) or retrieval (KV/cache hits)
4) Any PII/data residency constraints beyond US?
5) Who should we loop in on procurement for pilot terms?

What I recommend next (if Hosted is acceptable):
- Sandbox endpoints we provision: /v1/hosted/generate (primary), /v1/hosted/chat (conversational).
- Default pilot rate caps: 60 requests/min per endpoint and a token cap of 120k tokens/day. We can increase for pilot based on the workload CSV.
- Quickstart pack attached: redwood-quickstart-playbook.pdf (walkthrough), example-ratecaps.csv (format for your traffic profile).

Next steps
- If you can share the traffic numbers above, we’ll provision a sandbox and propose concrete rate caps and a short canary on Monday.
- Would you prefer a second 30-minute call to walk through the quickstart playbook with your engineering lead?

Thanks — looking forward to the data.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference for production
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@ledgerio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@ledgerio.com
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation — quick follow-up & questions

Marissa — thanks, great demo. Answers inline below.

1) Peak concurrent QPS: we expect ~40 requests/sec peak for the first month, trending to ~80 req/sec by month 6 if adoption goes well.
2) Tokens: avg input ~35 tokens, avg output ~48 tokens. Some longer contexts for case histories (~3% of calls at ~1500 tokens).
3) Retrieval: ~25% of requests will hit the vector DB; we’d want low latency on those.
4) Data residency: US only for now. SOC 2 is a must.
5) Procurement: copied procurement@ledgerio.com — they will handle pilot paperwork and NDAs.

We don’t have VPC requirements for the pilot — can start with hosted, but we want guidance on when to move to Dedicated (or Private) if traffic increases. Also: are you able to raise the pilot rate caps to 100 QPS for a 2-week stress run? That would help validate scaling assumptions.

Thanks — Alyssa
Alyssa Park
Head of Product, Ledgerio
alyssa@ledgerio.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation — quick follow-up & questions

Copying a short internal recommendation based on Alyssa’s numbers:

- Baseline: Hosted API pilot is fine. 40 QPS (peak) with avg ~83 tokens/request puts them under default hosted envelope but approaching a tier where we should consider reserved capacity.
- Pilot ask: we can grant a temporary elevated sandbox cap to 100 QPS for a 14-day stress run — requires an ops ticket and a signed pilot MPA.
- Suggested configuration for the demo/pilot:
  * Provision two sandbox endpoints: standard generate + streaming chat. Enable prefix/KV caching for retrieval flows.
  * Token bucket: set to 200k tokens/day during stress run, revert to requested 120k after.
  * Monitoring: enable per-route latency and token breakdown in the console; set a 5% quality alert threshold.
- Trigger point to move to Dedicated: sustained 60+ QPS over a 7-day window or predictable monthly spend > $20k/mo. Private/VPC to consider for strict network controls or long-term on-prem requirements.

Attachments I’ll add to the ops ticket: pilot-scope-draft.xlsx (I’ll attach the initial MAP). Will open the ops ticket once Marissa confirms.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation — next steps and sandbox provisioning

Alyssa / Procurement — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and checklist so we’re aligned: 

1) Ledgerio to share: traffic CSV in the example-ratecaps.csv format and an engineering contact for the 30-minute technical quickstart. (Alyssa, can you share that by Friday?)
2) Redwood will:
   - Provision sandbox endpoints (/v1/hosted/generate and /v1/hosted/chat) with an initial cap of 60 req/min per endpoint and 120k tokens/day.
   - Open ops ticket to temporarily raise the sandbox to 100 QPS and 200k tokens/day for a 14-day stress run once we have the signed pilot MPA.
   - Enable prefix/KV caching for the sandbox and turn on per-route latency dashboards.
3) Procurement: please review the attached pilot-scope-draft.xlsx and the DocuSign I’ve shared (link below). We’ll need a signed MPA to enable the elevated sandbox cap.

Proposed slots for the technical quickstart: Thu 10/7 11am PT or Fri 10/8 9am PT — which works?
